title: Data analysis
description: Analyze approved data with provenance, quality, mathematical review when relevant, and independent result verification.
intent: Answer the bounded data question using actual approved inputs, or deliver a clearly labeled analysis plan when inputs are unavailable. Preserve raw data; production writes and external uploads are not implied.

assignments.task: Define the decision, grain, time window, metrics, denominators, provenance, and data-quality checks.
Review consequential formulas, numerical assumptions, and comparison tolerances.
assignments.when: The analysis needs nontrivial mathematical modeling or numerical methods.

assignments.task: Review causal identification, experimental assumptions, bias, and uncertainty.
assignments.when: The question concerns causal effects, experiments, or inferential conclusions.

assignments.task: Review privacy, access, and disclosure boundaries without accessing unrelated records.
assignments.when: The data or requested outputs include sensitive or restricted information.

assignments.task: Perform scoped read-only/local analysis on approved inputs; return traceable tables/charts, interpretation, methods, and gaps.
Save only requested reports/queries/notebooks/visualizations, preserving raw inputs and user edits; verify artifact contents.
assignments.when: The user requests saved reproducible analysis artifacts.

assignments.task: Check the completed analysis claims, provenance, transformations, totals, denominators, uncertainty, and independent references.
Check executable analysis artifacts for reproducibility and meaningful edge cases without editing.
assignments.when: Executable analysis artifacts were created or changed.

completion: The answer is supported by actual approved data or explicitly limited to a plan/provided evidence.
Definitions, filters, time windows, denominators, transformations, and uncertainty are disclosed.
Independent checks follow completed analysis/artifacts, and source data is preserved.
